levels.surface: أبو الطاهر، أحمد بن عمرو بن سرح

notes: two sayings: the Ibn Mas'ud saying runs through this chain; Hudhayfa's own account of the Prophet («فإني سمعت رسول الله») is a second saying with no separate isnad in the text, so its link is not written
a kunya, a comma and a name are one man (أبو الطاهر، أحمد بن عمرو بن سرح)
